summary: This class provides a static method that converts human-readable titles into URL-friendly slugs by lowercasing the text, replacing non-alphanumeric characters with dashes, and cleaning up the result. It throws an error if the input would produce an empty slug, ensuring we never return meaningless output.

explanations.3: This declares that all function parameters and return types in this file must be strictly typed — PHP will reject type mismatches rather than silently converting them.
explanations.14: We trim whitespace from the edges and convert everything to lowercase so 'The Best Thing' becomes 'the best thing'.
explanations.18: This regex replaces any sequence of one or more characters that aren't letters or digits with a single dash, so 'the best-thing!' becomes 'the-best-thing'.
explanations.19: We cast the result to a string (in case preg_replace returns null) and trim any dashes from the start and end, so 'the-best-thing' stays 'the-best-thing' but '-the-best-thing-' becomes 'the-best-thing'.
